Find below a list of my publications, their DOI, and a PDF copy of the manuscript.

---

```{r pubs}
# Load required packages
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

# Read data file and transform
papers <- as_tibble(readxl::read_excel("data/papers.xlsx")) %>% 
  filter(logical) %>%  # Assuming 'logical' is a column that determines whether to include the row
  mutate(
    authors = gsub("Rodrigo R. Granjel", "<u>Rodrigo R. Granjel</u>", authors)  # Highlight your name
  )
```


```{r submitted, results='asis'}
# filter for published papers only
submitted_papers <- papers %>%
  filter(status == "submitted") %>%
  arrange(-index)

# check if there are any published papers
if (nrow(submitted_papers) > 0) {
  # create a kable table for published papers with the desired structure
  kable_submitted <- submitted_papers %>%
    mutate(
      content = paste0("<br/>",
        "<strong>", title, "</strong>", "<br/>",
        authors, "<br/>", "<br/>"
        )
    ) %>%
    select(content) %>% # select only the content for output
    kable("html",
          escape = FALSE,
          col.names = NULL,
          linesep = "\\addlinespace") %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"), 
      full_width = TRUE, 
      position = "left"
    )

  # display header and kable output
  cat("<h3>Submitted papers</h3>")
  print(kable_submitted)
}
```


```{r preprints, results='asis'}
# filter for published papers only
preprints <- papers %>%
  filter(status == "preprint") %>%
  arrange(-index)

# check if there are any published papers
if (nrow(preprints) > 0) {
  # create a kable table for published papers with the desired structure
  kable_preprints <- preprints %>%
    mutate(
      content = paste0("<br/>",
        "<strong>", title, "</strong>", "<br/>",
        authors, "<br/>",
        "<i>", journal, "</i>, ", year, "<br/>",
        "<a href='", doi, "' class='button doi-button'>DOI</a> ",
        ifelse(!is.na(pdf), 
               paste0("<a href='", file.path("docs/papers", pdf), "' class='button pdf-button'>PDF</a>"), 
               "<span>No PDF Available</span>"),
```

